Second-population slice C (features): close construction on SidecarManifest, FeatureRef, and FeatureDerivation.

All are public case classes. SidecarManifest and FeatureRef have self-returning validators (sub-shape a) — must BUILD field-level constructors. FeatureDerivation already has of(...) (Gold-like hybrid); close the public constructor that align/window/tests still use.

Copy the landed probe on main (2ddbcd5 ConstructionProbeSuite / storymodel4s.benchprobe). Probe package storymodel4s.featuresprobe. Forge first from outside storymodel4s.features. Same-shape positive control: a remaining public case class in features, not Coverage, not a tuple. typeCheckErrors. Clean recompile. Format check last.
